{{Top|leg}}
'''Life Bond''' was a [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] that allowed a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-user]] to permanently form a mental link with another person. The [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Gorc]] and [[Picaroon C. Boodle]] possessed a life-bond, allowing them to share senses and granting them limited [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathy]], in addition to linking their susceptibility to injury and the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark side of the Force]]. Upon [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kyle Katarn]]'s [[Death/Legends|killing]] of Gorc, Pic's bond sent him into a violent frenzy.<ref name="Dark Forces">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050609a|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 5: Two Peas in a Pod}}</ref>
